L2985: The goal of this paper is to establish Rothe type fixed point theorems and related general Leray-Schaduer principle for non-self compact upper semicontinuous (USC) Set-valued mappings in Hausdorff topological vector spaces (TVSs).
L2986: In particular, we first establish fixed point theorems for set-valued self-mappings with local intersection property (LIP), and compact upper semicontinuous set-valued self mappings in Hausdorff p-vector spaces or TVSs by using the functional analysis approach, then the general Rothe type fixed point theorem for non-self mapping in TVSs is established first time for Hausdorff TVSs, which is then used to establish the general framework of Leray-Schauder principle for compact USC set-valued mappings in TVSs.
L2987: In addition, the general existence of maximal elements of preference mappings are used established for the generalized games and optimizations. The results developed in this paper do not only provide a unified positive answer to Schauder conjecture completely in TVSs, but also unify corresponding results of fixed point theory and related nonlinear analysis and applications in the existing literature, where $p \in (0, 1]$.
L2988: In particular, for the self-containing, the most fundamental results required by this paper are provided by the Appendix A enclosed in this paper to show the important role of the so-called \textbf{Yuan's Sharpness Operator} used, which allows us to establish the general fixed point theory in TVSs and provide the positive solutions to Schauder conjecture (Problem 54), and Eilenberg's Problem 138 recorded by Scottish Book without using Hahn-Banach theory in traditional functional analysis method.
L2989: Finally, the new theory and method given in the Appendix of the paper also provide the full correction (Errata) of all proofs （with some GAPS) for all results (and indeed, all correct, too) given by the Appendix A and Appendix B in the paper "G.X. L19: ## Abstract
L20: In this short report, we do establish a refined structural property of the continuous partition of unity on compact Hausdorff spaces, referred to as the Yuan's Dominant δ-Gap Lemma. By employing a structural shrinking of finite open covers and a symmetry-breaking multi-plicative perturbation, we prove the existence of a partition where a unique principal component is uniformly separated from all other components by a constant δ > 0 across the entire domain.
L21: This lemma serves as a robust selection tool for addressing long-standing open problems in functional analysis and nonlinear operator theory.
